per_question.question: What is the fee refund timeline if a student withdraws from a course?
per_question.answer:
The fee refund timeline is as follows:
- 100% refund if withdrawal is made up to the 10th day of commencement of classes
- 80% refund if withdrawal is made up to the 15th day of commencement of classes
- 60% refund if withdrawal is made up to the 20th day of commencement of classes
- 50% refund if withdrawal is made up to the 30th day of commencement of classes
- No refund if withdrawal is made after the 31st day of commencement of classes.
